title: Kuro from your original 3D workflow, ChatGPT pictures (kuro-meshy-orig-2)
blurb: A real rigged 3D model: the picture steps in ChatGPT's image model (GPT Image 2) with your words, then Meshy smart topology (1,050 polygons, A-pose), textured in a second pass, Meshy auto-rig at 1.1 m. Idle and walk are the game's (Mio's approved idle and walk, carried over by bone name). Beside her: the in-game Meshy Eric and Mio, playing the same moves. Drag to turn, wheel to zoom.
